Journalist Arrested Amid Allegations of Coercion in Rape Complaint Against MLA

A man has been arrested for allegedly coercing a minor to file a 'false' rape complaint against a Jharkhand Congress MLA. Separately, police reportedly raided the Ranchi office of digital news channel Bharatmitra, whose journalist Abhishek Bharti is stated to have exposed the Congress MLA in a minor rape case. The coverage does not specify the current status of the MLA or the rape complaint.
